description: This file defines the WebBridge class, which implements plugin interfaces for a web-based plugin system, including WebSocket and dispatcher functionalities. It includes nested classes for managing observers, requests, and configuration, as well as methods for initialization, message handling, and subscription management.

classes.name: WebBridge
classes.description: Main class implementing plugin interfaces for WebSocket communication, dispatching, and plugin lifecycle management.

classes.name: WebBridge::Observer
classes.description: Represents an observer with an ID and designator, used for managing subscriptions.

classes.name: WebBridge::Request
classes.description: Represents a request with channel ID, sequence ID, and timestamp.

classes.name: WebBridge::Cleaner
classes.description: A job class for cleaning up resources, scheduled via a worker pool.

classes.name: WebBridge::Config
classes.description: Configuration container class with JSON serialization for plugin settings.

methods.name: WebBridge::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: WebBridge::Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: WebBridge::Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound messages from WebSocket or other sources.

methods.name: WebBridge::Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of pending requests and observers.

methods.name: WebBridge::HasMethodSupport
methods.description: Checks if a method is supported in a given version map.

methods.name: WebBridge::Destination
methods.description: Determines the destination state based on the designator and handler.

methods.name: WebBridge::Subscribe
methods.description: Registers an observer for an event.

methods.name: WebBridge::Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes an observer from an event.
